governance_patch.purpose: Make repository artifact hygiene an explicit governance requirement so campaign runs, validation scripts, audits, and generated configs never pollute the repository root.

repo_root_rule.statement: The repository root is not a run-output location.

all_run_scripts_must: default output to results/<run_id>/ if no output path is supplied
write raw outputs under results/<run_id>/raw/ or results/<run_id>/outputs/
persist the resolved config used for the run
never write generated artifacts to CWD unless CWD is an approved run directory

global_validate_must_check: no generated run directories in repo root
no generated config files in repo root
no malformed template-expansion filenames in repo root
all recent campaign artifacts are under results/
all audit reports are under outputs/audits/
all validation reports are under outputs/validation/

git_hygiene.rule: Ignoring artifacts is not a substitute for writing them to the correct location. Scripts must still be patched.

steps.action: Move dt_sweep_*_out/ and dt_sweep_*.json into legacy cleanup directory.
Move fv_*_out/ and fv_*_config.json into legacy cleanup directory.
Move uq_seed_*_out/ and uq_seed_*_config.json into legacy cleanup directory.
Move lex_val_*, lex_multi_tri_*, cross_* artifacts into legacy cleanup directory.
Move malformed '@+$outJson+@' and '@+$outMd+@' files into results/_legacy_bad_filenames/.
Patch offending scripts to use canonical landing zones.
Confirm git status shows only intentional source/governance changes.

claim_governance_connection.rule: Campaign claims may not be promoted if artifact provenance is polluted or unrecoverable.

instructions: Before running any campaign or validation script, determine the canonical run directory.
Never allow generated artifacts to land in repository root.
Patch scripts that write to CWD before executing them.
Preserve resolved configs, raw outputs, reports, logs, seeds, and backend metadata under the run directory.
After execution, run global validation and report any hygiene violations.
Do not promote rigor or publish status while artifact hygiene checks fail.

patch_is_complete_when: offending scripts no longer write configs or outputs to repo root
legacy root artifacts are moved under results/
global_validate.py fails on future root pollution
a new campaign run produces no repo-root artifacts
claim gate refuses promotion when artifact hygiene fails
